_comment: Phase-8 XGBoost tree ensemble fixture: an XGBClassifier (5 estimators, max_depth=3) trained on Wisconsin Breast Cancer (30 features, 2 classes) lowered via penumbra.adapters.from_xgboost into a 4-node IR graph (split_cmp -> leaf_score -> leaf_sel -> logits). FHE output must equal these quantized-cleartext logits/labels bit-for-bit (AGENTS.md §1.1).
